evals.prompt: 根据 game-loop-note.md 生成 5 道 Omni Quiz 测试题，保存为 game-loop-note.quiz.md。只依据笔记内容出题。
evals.expected_output: A valid five-question Chinese Omni Quiz Markdown file grounded in the source note.
expectations: The output is a Markdown file with frontmatter type quiz and exactly one quiz fenced block.
The quiz JSON passes scripts/validate-quiz.mjs and contains exactly five questions.
Every question is supported by the source note and has one unambiguous answer.

evals.prompt: 优化 existing.quiz.md 里 q001 的题干和干扰项，再增加一道关于 delta time 的题。保留已有答题记录的对应关系。
evals.expected_output: An updated valid quiz that preserves the existing quiz ID and q001 ID, with one newly assigned question ID.
expectations: quiz.id remains game-loop-quiz-001 and the revised original question remains q001.
The new delta-time question uses a new, non-recycled question ID.
No progress fields such as selectedAnswer, correct, attempts, or updatedAt are written.

evals.prompt: 把这段话做成 10 道四选一测试题：对象池会复用短生命周期对象，减少频繁创建销毁的开销。
evals.expected_output: A valid quiz with only as many distinct grounded questions as the very short source can support, plus a clear limitation note rather than fabricated material.
expectations: The output does not fabricate concepts absent from the one-sentence source.
The response explicitly reports that the source cannot support ten distinct high-quality questions if fewer are generated.
